data.title: Split and Say 5!
data.description: Learn to split a whole into parts and say one part using counters.

challenges.instruction: Let's split 3 counters into two parts and say one part!
Great job! Now let's find all the ways to split 4 into parts.
You are doing amazing! Can you find every way to split 5?
